basic_info.description: Experience the best of city living in this boutique elevator building in Noe Valley. Boasting soaring ceilings, oversized windows, and a flexible open floor plan, this elegant residence combines loft-like volume with timeless finishes. The home features a gracious foyer with coat closet, engineered wood floors throughout, and a versatile den with custom built-ins: ideal as a home office or guest quarters. The refreshed kitchen showcases quartz countertops, maple cabinetry, and a suite of stainless-steel appliances, opening seamlessly to the dining and living areas.The tranquil primary bedroom offers generous natural light and peaceful views, while the remodeled bath and updated fixtures add a modern touch. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry, deeded secure parking with three storage cabinets, and a massive, sun-drenched shared garden with park-like landscaping. Located in a professionally managed, gated building originally converted from the historic St. Paul's High School, this top-floor-feel unit offers privacy with no living space directly above most of the home. Moments from Church Street's shops, restaurants, and transit, and with easy freeway access, this is an exceptional opportunity to own in one of San Francisco's most coveted and sunniest neighborhoods.
